_about: The pages of each volume shown in the Handbook Library's preview viewer, chosen by what they show. tools/upsc/build_upsc.py renders exactly these pages (and the cover, page 1) from the private PDFs as clean images, with no watermark or overlay, and deletes any image no longer listed. The owner's brief: about 8 pages per volume (at least 5, at most 10), ideally 1 contents, 2 a strong conceptual explanation, 3 an infographic or diagram, 4 a detailed topic or policy explanation, 5 a table or data presentation, 6 a case study, scheme or institution, 7 an examination-oriented application, 8 another high-value page. tools/upsc/propose_pages.py ranks the candidates. Until the PDFs are run, each volume lists the three pages that already exist as images (contents and two samples).
